description: Get the full agenticness evaluation breakdown: 9 dimensions (action capability, autonomy, planning, adaptation, state continuity, reliability, interoperability, safety, operator sovereignty) scored 0-4 each (max 36, Agenticness rubric v3.1) with evidence-based reasoning. Use this for deep analysis of one tool's AI agent capabilities. For a quick score, get_listing includes the overall score. For comparing scores, use compare_listings.
